entries.title: I Chronicles 19:1
segments: ¶It happened after this that Nahash the king of the people of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:2
segments: Then David said, "I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came to Hanun in the land of the people of Ammon to comfort him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:3
segments: And the princes of the people of Ammon said to Hanun, "Do you think that David really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Did his servants not come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?"

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:4
segments: Therefore Hanun took David's servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, at their buttocks, and sent them away.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:5
segments: Then [some] went and told David about the men; and he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, "Wait at Jericho until your beards have grown, and [then] return."

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:6
segments: ¶When the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves repulsive to David, Hanun and the people of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Syrian Maachah, and from Zobah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:7
segments: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, with the king of Maachah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. Also the people of Ammon gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:8
segments: Now when David heard [of it], he sent Joab and all the army of the mighty men.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:9
segments: Then the people of Ammon came out and put themselves in battle array before the gate of the city, and the kings who had come [were] by themselves in the field.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:10
segments: When Joab saw that the battle line was against him before and behind, he chose some of Israel's best and put [them] in battle array against the Syrians.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:11
segments: And the rest of the people he put under the command of Abishai his brother, and they set [themselves] in battle array against the people of Ammon.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:12
segments: Then he said, "If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the people of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:13
segments: "Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. And may the LORD do [what is] good in His sight."

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:14
segments: So Joab and the people who [were] with him drew near for the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:15
segments: When the people of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai his brother, and entered the city. So Joab went to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:16
segments: Now when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought the Syrians who were beyond the River, and Shophach the commander of Hadadezer's army [went] before them.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:17
segments: When it was told David, he gathered all Israel, crossed over the Jordan and came upon them, and set up in battle array against them. So when David had set up in [battle] array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:18
segments: Then the Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers of the Syrians, and killed Shophach the commander of the army.

entries.title: I Chronicles 19:19
segments: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants. So the Syrians were not willing to help the people of Ammon anymore.
